title: 3awadi released his newest single titled "Great Dane"
htmlContent:
Australia-based artist and poet 3awadi released a new single titled "Great Dane," an energetic hip-hop rap with a playful, upbeat sound that you can dance to.

Great Dane is a playful, energetic hip-hop song that is one of a kind. It is a funny yet steamy bop that is all about relationships with men, and no matter how loving they can be, men can be dogs sometimes.

"Great Dane' is a song you want to play while driving. It keeps you vibing to the incredible performance, and the poetic verses in between that fill you with laughter and joy.

3awadi is a successful poet in Australia and is now making a career of himself as a rapper. Hearing so much about him, we had to feature him on our page.
